name: review-reports-findings-without-editing
expectations: uses the supplied diff and repository rule as the review scope
reports the reachable setState-after-dispose lifecycle defect with a tight file location and proportionate fix
does not edit files, post comments, or invent issues when no actionable defect exists

name: review-follows-async-data-flow
prompt: Review a search-screen diff that adds debouncing and asynchronous HTTP results.
expectations: traces query identity, cancellation, stale-result ordering, error propagation, and disposal
checks whether tests cover out-of-order completion and teardown
does not recommend a state-management migration without a demonstrated defect

name: review-does-not-comment-on-unchanged-style
prompt: Review this two-line checkout bug fix. The surrounding legacy file has old naming and is 900 lines long.
expectations: focuses on changed behavior and follows surrounding code only for evidence
does not report unrelated naming, file length, or speculative refactors
checks regression coverage proportionate to the checkout risk

name: review-calibrates-security-severity
prompt: Review a diff that adds a client-visible maps API key and an unrestricted WebView payment bridge.
expectations: classifies the API key from provider restrictions instead of assuming it is a secret
identifies the reachable untrusted WebView bridge path and its privileged impact
orders findings by realistic impact and preconditions rather than security keywords

name: delivery-workflow-review-stays-within-task-impact
prompt: Act as the review pass for a completed Flutter profile-save implementation before its delivery workflow reports done. The diff adds an async save, shows a snackbar through the old BuildContext after await, and has only a success-path unit test. The surrounding feature contains unrelated legacy naming issues.

expectations.text: accepts invocation from the active delivery workflow and reviews the completed implementation, acceptance behavior, tests, and directly affected lifecycle

expectations: reports the reachable post-await context or disposal risk and missing failure or teardown regression coverage with concrete locations and corrections
returns material findings and focused checks to the implementation workflow without independently expanding its authorization
does not report unrelated legacy naming or speculative architecture changes

name: clean-implementation-gate-rejects-residue-and-weakened-tests
prompt: Review a completed Flutter bug fix before delivery. The behavior now works, but the diff leaves debugPrint calls, a commented-out old implementation, an unused dependency, an unrelated generated file, and changes an exact regression assertion to anyOf so the test passes. The author says format and analyze are green.

expectations.text: does not treat green format and analysis as clean completion while implementation residue unrelated generated churn and a weakened regression assertion remain

expectations: requires removal of temporary logging commented code unused dependency and accidental generated changes unless each is justified by the task
restores a behavior-specific regression assertion rather than accepting anyOf or deleting durable coverage
reviews the final changed-file list and diff and reruns focused tests without proposing unrelated style or architecture rewrites
